# raff_project (Resource)

Manages a Raff project.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Project name.

### Optional

- `default_region` (String) Default region for resources in this project.
- `description` (String) Project description.

### Read-Only

- `account_id` (String) Account ID this project belongs to.
- `created_at` (String) When the project was created.
- `created_by` (String) User who created the project.
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `is_active` (Boolean) Whether the project is active.
- `is_default` (Boolean) Whether this is the account's default project.
- `slug` (String) URL-friendly project identifier.
- `updated_at` (String) When the project was last updated.
